**Fourth + Mac is Now Renting. Book A Tour and Move-in Today! **
Kitsilano is a neighbourhood known for epic mountain views, sunset beach runs, patio culture and a walk-everywhere lifestyle. Located on the corner of West 4th Ave and Macdonald Street, Fourth + Mac is in the center of it all (and just a flip-flop away from the beach). The building offers studio, 1 and 2 bedroom rental homes with a natural design palette, so you can easily make the space your own.
